name: Steamtech Last Destination
text: When this card is activated target 1 level 8 or higher 'Steamtech' Fusion or Synchro Monster you control, that monster gains 500 ATK. If that targeted monster is destroyed while you have at least 4 other 'Steamtech' Fusion or Synchro monsters in your GY you can banish that targeted monster and 2 other 'Steamtech' Fusion or Synchro monsters from your GY Special Summon 1 'Steamtech Final Dragon Weapon' from your Extra Deck. (This is treated as an Xys Summon.)
